title: Antifibrotic hydrogel strategies for scarless tissue regeneration: mechanisms, design, and application

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Antifibrotic hydrogel strategies for scarless tissue regeneration: mechanisms, design, and application》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Tissue repair is a highly coordinated process, yet dysregulated fibrosis often diverts healing toward scar formation, resulting in permanent structural and functional impairment.
